argument: Six apertures must read as cavities in one wrong slab before they read as six interactive targets. The silhouette, mass, shadow, and uneven internal cuts must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v042's volume, v043's orbit, and v044's wall. It should read as one hollow object with an impossible seal, not a card field, diagram, or brush demo.

The viewer must press, dwell, push through, return, and release. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and deterministic control paths must share the same causal event; no essential action may depend on hover or hardware pressure.
Samples may accumulate without changing geometry. Only strong pressure plus a return can commit; the source cavity must remain exact while a different cavity gains an actual polygonal membrane.
Pressure must change the generated membrane's extent, twist, and irregularity. These are geometry-producing consequences, not a brush texture painted over a fixed image.
A weak dwell, a missing return, a one-way push, an outside press, and an empty release must remain geometry-neutral. The release gate is the only commit condition.
Four membranes must compound in one slab. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding geometry and release must return to the deterministic hollow object.
The generated Canvas silhouette, cavities, rims, cut planes, and membranes are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or stock particle library may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from pressure and directional production into a wrong reconstruction law. Brushes, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, composition, code, examples, and API surface are refused.

Delete v045 if the blind slab is another field, if pressure only changes a cursor, if source matter deforms, if the membrane is cosmetic, if all traces coincide, if later memory resets, or if exact lifting fails.
